title: Code and data for: Magnetic nanoparticle aggregation in tumor tissue can cancel most of the planned thermoradiotherapy benefit: a particle-to-outcome model
description: Kinetic Monte Carlo, heat-transfer, thermoradiobiology, surrogate-model (ANN, GBT and smooth baselines), cost and exact-design scripts and data for the manuscript. v1.3.0 adds smooth surrogate baselines (polynomial, spline, RBF, Gaussian process), single-core timing of KMC and surrogates, and exact KMC refinement of surrogate designs.
